name: Cuckoo Mask
source:
You miss the last train of the day, you feel lost, you need a place where you can stay. You stumble upon a masked party… and see a girl who looks like your girlfriend! Everyone wears a mask, everyone is horny, and the owner of the house is nowhere to be seen.

Coincidentally, it seems that no one you meet is inclined to treat you well. But the weird thing is… it looks like you’re enjoying that!

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hasselnut/cuckoo-mask/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
错过末班车的你，茫然无措，需要找个地方过夜。你偶然闯入一场假面派对……竟看见一个酷似自己女友的女孩！每个人都戴着面具，每个人都欲望高涨，屋主却不知所踪。

巧的是，你遇见的人似乎都不打算善待你。奇怪的是……你好像还挺享受！

[摘自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hasselnut/cuckoo-mask/description]Kickstarter[/url]]
